name: Location tag
description: A map-pin style tag with a place name and optional coordinates. Slides in, floats gently, slides out.

lang.label: Language
lang.description: The language of both lines as a tag: ja, zh-Hant, ko, en. Kanji are drawn in the forms this language uses, and a character the font lacks falls back to a font for it. Empty keeps the page's own, English.
